NVIDIA Post-Earnings Analysis — Calendar 2026Q2 label / Fiscal Q1 2027
Release date: May 20, 2026. Quarter ended: April 26, 2026.

No contemporaneous Preview exists. This Analysis cannot compare results against a prior forecast. It uses the prior quarter, the year-ago quarter, and the company's new outlook as benchmarks.

Actual results:
Revenue was $81.615 billion, up 20% sequentially and 85% year over year. GAAP diluted EPS was $2.39. Non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.87. GAAP gross margin was 74.9%. Non-GAAP gross margin was 75.0%. The prior quarter revenue was $68.127 billion. The year-ago quarter revenue was $44.062 billion.

Segment results under the new framework:
Data Center revenue was $75.2 billion, up 92% year over year. Edge Computing revenue was $6.4 billion, up 29% year over year. Under the old classification, Data Center compute revenue was $60.4 billion, up 77% year over year. Data Center networking revenue was $14.8 billion, up 199% year over year. Compute plus networking equals the Data Center total.

Non-GAAP methodology change:
From this quarter, non-GAAP measures no longer exclude stock-based compensation expense. GAAP net income was $58.321 billion. Non-GAAP net income was $45.548 billion. GAAP included about $15.9 billion of gains from equity securities. Non-GAAP excludes these gains. This explains why GAAP net income is higher than non-GAAP net income.

Cash flow and capital returns:
Operating cash flow was $50.344 billion. NVIDIA returned about $20.0 billion to shareholders via repurchases and dividends. The Board added $80.0 billion to the repurchase authorization. The quarterly dividend increases from $0.01 to $0.25 per share, payable June 26, 2026.

Company outlook for fiscal Q2 2027:
Revenue is expected to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. The outlook assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China. GAAP gross margin is expected to be 74.9%. Non-GAAP gross margin is expected to be 75.0%. Both carry a range of plus or minus 50 basis points. GAAP operating expenses are expected to be about $8.5 billion. Non-GAAP operating expenses are expected to be about $8.3 billion. The full-year tax rate is expected to be between 16% and 18%.

Assessment and next-quarter watch items:
The results confirm the AI factory buildout and agentic AI demand as the main growth drivers. Networking growth of 199% supports the optics and NVLink investment theme. Gross margin stayed near 75%. The main uncertainty is China: the company excludes Chinese Data Center compute revenue from its outlook. Watch the Hyperscale versus ACIE split, Vera Rubin platform ramp, and gross margin stability.
reader_questions: 为什么非 GAAP 净利润（455.48 亿美元）反而低于 GAAP 净利润（583.21 亿美元）？差异是否全部来自非 GAAP 口径变化？
公司指引称“不假设任何来自中国的数据中心计算收入”，这对 910 亿美元收入指引的影响有多大？来源是否给出了量化数字？
新披露框架下的 Edge Computing 是否把原来分散的汽车、机器人、PC、工作站等收入全部并入？与旧口径历史数据是否可比？
fact_checks: 第一轮核对（逐项对照来源）：发布日为 2026-05-20，标题与来源匹配；季度为 FY2027 第一财季（截至 2026-04-26），任务标签 2026Q2 指发布日所在日历季度。收入 81,615 百万美元，环比 +20%（68,127→81,615）、同比 +85%（44,062→81,615），核对一致。GAAP 摊薄 EPS 2.39 美元、非 GAAP 1.87 美元；GAAP 毛利率 74.9%、非 GAAP 75.0%，一致。数据中心 75.2B 与旧口径计算收入 60.4B + 网络收入 14.8B 勾稽一致（75.2B）；边缘计算 6.4B 与总收入差额一致。非 GAAP 口径变化（本季起不再剔除股权激励费用）为来源明示；非 GAAP 净利润（45,548）低于 GAAP 净利润（58,321）的原因是 GAAP 计入约 159 亿美元股权证券收益，来源现金流表调整项为 15,936 百万美元。经营现金流 50,344 百万美元、股东返还约 200 亿美元、新增 800 亿美元回购授权、季度股息 0.01→0.25 美元（6/26 支付），均一致。FY2027 第二财季指引：收入 91.0B ±2%、不含中国数据中心计算收入、毛利率 GAAP 74.9%/非 GAAP 75.0% ±50bp、经营费用 GAAP 约 8.5B/非 GAAP 约 8.3B、全财年税率 16%–18%，均一致。来源正文未含市场共识数字，本稿未引用任何外部共识、股价或未披露产品利润。

第二轮互检（扮演怀疑的初次阅读者）：提出 3 个会改变理解的问题（见 reader_questions），并据此修改正文。1）非 GAAP 净利润低于 GAAP 的倒挂现象，正文已用口径变化与股权证券收益解释，句子只承载该一个判断。2）中国排除影响的量化无法从来源获得，正文只转述公司指引原话“不含任何来自中国的数据中心计算收入”，并将中国政策列为下季风险，不编造影响金额。3）Edge Computing 为首次披露的新口径，正文明确标注“新框架首秀”，未与旧口径历史数据直接做同比比较，避免误导。结论与证据对应关系复核通过，未发现编造数字或日期错位。
